claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic utilizes a run rule (mercy rule) to end games early if one team leads by 10 or more runs after 7 innings.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic utilizes a run rule (mercy rule) to end games early if one team leads by 15 or more runs after 5 innings.
The mercy rule applies to pool play and quarterfinals in the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
The mercy rule does not apply to semifinals or final games in the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
The 15-Run Rule ends the game if a team leads by 15 or more runs after 5 innings in the World Baseball Classic.
The 15-Run Rule ends the game after 4½ innings if the home team is winning by 15 or more runs in the World Baseball Classic.
The 10-Run Rule ends the game if a team leads by 10 or more runs after 7 innings in the World Baseball Classic.
The 10-Run Rule ends the game after 6½ innings if the home team is winning by 10 or more runs in the World Baseball Classic.
Japan beat Chinese Taipei 13-0 in seven innings in pool play of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Dominican Republic defeated Netherlands 12-1 in seven innings in quarterfinals of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Chinese Taipei beat Czechia 14-0 in seven innings in the 2026 World Baseball Classic
